title: 옷 가게에서: 교환하고 싶어요, 환불하고 싶어요
objective: You can ask for an exchange or refund with -고 싶어요 and say what is wrong.
summary: A customer at a clothing store asks to exchange a T-shirt, then asks for a refund.
setting: At the counter of a clothing store. A customer brings back a T-shirt they bought yesterday.

task.title: Ask for an exchange or refund
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, change, arrange, or answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: I exchanged it for a blue one.

words.meaning: to get a refund (or give one)
words.exampleMeaning: I got a refund for the bag. It was too expensive.
Please be sure to bring the receipt.
Do you have it in size M?

words.meaning: to be small (too tight to wear)
words.exampleMeaning: The shoes are a little small.

words.meaning: to be big (too loose to wear)
to change, to swap (one item for another)
words.exampleMeaning: Please swap it for a black one.
In that case, I'll take this one.

dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange this T-shirt.

dialogue.korean: 사이즈가 좀 작아요. 큰 사이즈 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: The size is a bit small. Do you have a bigger size?

dialogue.korean: 죄송합니다. 그 색은 큰 사이즈가 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry. We don't have a bigger size in that color.
OK. Do you have the receipt?

dialogue.korean: 네, 여기 있어요. 어제 카드로 샀어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, here it is. I paid by card yesterday.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 신발이 작아요. 큰 사이즈로 (교환 / 영수증)하고 싶어요. ② 바지가 너무 (커요 / 작아요). 작은 사이즈로 바꾸고 싶어요.
Change the verb to the -고 싶어요 form: ① 이 우산을 환불하다 ② 다른 색으로 바꾸다
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 싶어요 / 이 / 교환하고 / 치마를
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 손님은 왜 교환을 못 하고 환불해요?
answers: ① 이 우산을 환불하고 싶어요. ② 다른 색으로 바꾸고 싶어요.
큰 사이즈가 없어요. (그 색은 큰 사이즈가 없어요.)
